title: Chocolate beverage powder, light, dry mix, not reconstituted

content.title: About
content.content: Chocolate beverage powder is a light dry mix designed for preparing a hot or cold chocolate drink without the need for liquid during manufacturing. The blend typically contains cocoa powder, sweeteners, emulsifiers and flavorings, delivering a rich chocolate taste and creamy texture once reconstituted with water or milk.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Dry mixes allow rapid preparation of a drink in any setting, even without electricity.
The light formula reduces fat content compared with traditional chocolate beverages.
Many mixes are fortified with vitamins and minerals such as calcium and vitamin D to boost nutritional value.
Cocoa powder may be natural or alkalized (Dutch‑processed) to improve solubility.
Dry chocolate drinks are popular in military rations and expedition kits because of their long shelf life.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa provides flavonoids that may support cardiovascular health and reduce oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of magnesium
items.content: Magnesium in cocoa is important for normal muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Phenylethylamine and theobromine in cocoa can help improve mood and boost energy.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The light formulation offers lower saturated fat compared with conventional chocolate drinks.

items.title: Vitamin enrichment
items.content: Some versions are fortified with B‑vitamins and vitamin D, beneficial when fresh foods are limited.

items.title: Allergy to cocoa or additives
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to cocoa, dairy components or flavorings used in the mix.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Despite being light, the mix may contain added sweeteners, which should be considered by people with diabetes.

items.title: Caffeine and theobromine
items.content: Cocoa contains small amounts of theobromine, which can affect caffeine‑sensitive individuals.

items.title: Improper reconstitution
items.content: Using insufficient liquid can lead to clumping and an overly thick beverage.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Dissolve 1‑2 tablespoons of the mix in 200‑250 ml of hot (80‑90 °C) or cold water/milk, stirring vigorously with a whisk or blender until smooth. Optional additions include cream, vanilla or spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry mix in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Shelf life is typically 12‑24 months; after opening, use within 3‑6 months.
